verdict.rationale: Docusign's documented templates are reusable templates that users build and share with their team, plus CLM dynamic templates for generating contracts. That is an adjacent capability, not a library of pre-vetted standard legal documents such as NDAs or policies that would replace counsel. The pack has no evidence of a vetted legal template library.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start from a library of vetted standard legal templates (NDAs, agreements, policies) instead of hiring counsel for routine documents
